name_reason: Renamed __shared -> __ch28. The '41' is dispatch idx 0x41 (entry @ 0x51C95). idx 0x41 is reached ONLY in ch28 via tile-step event_type 0x00; ch27's turn-event slot 1 (code=0x41) is a turn=0xFF sentinel that is never armed -- an exhaustive src search finds the only writers of tile_event_data_table[+6] (slot-1 turn byte) are handler_43 (ch28), handler_4b/4c (ch29), and handler_1e (ch9); no ch27-reachable handler (0x3E/0x54/0x40) writes +6, so idx 0x41 never dispatches in ch27. The former '__shared' overstated the reach. 'dyn_turn_event' is accurate (gated first-time scheduler, cf. handler_3E); category state_machine_mutator kept.
purpose: First-time dynamic turn-event scheduler for chapter 28's tile-step: on first hit it arms a turn-event for the CURRENT turn (no +1; hook 0 -> event code idx 0x42) then locks out its own slot. (ch27's slot-1 reference to idx 0x41 is a never-armed turn=0xFF sentinel, so this is single-chapter ch28.)
logic_summary: Dispatched via per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 at idx 0x41 (entry @ 0x51C95). 1-arg cdecl ABI (event_arg unused). PUSH 4 / CALL __CHK (0x36cd7) stack-frame probe. If tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] == 0 (MOV EAX,[0x53ad5]; CMP byte [EAX+0x10],0): store (byte) data_fd2_battle_turn_counter (MOV DL,byte [0x53bef]) into tile_event_data_table[+3] (MOV EAX,[0x53a55]; MOV byte [EAX+3],DL) -- hook entry 0's turn byte, arming a turn-event at the current turn with NO increment (distinct from handler_3E which writes turn_counter+1) -- then set the consume flag tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] = 1. Return. Byte read + byte store reproduce the exact 8-bit move.
